title: api: schema versioning - deprecations, beta headers, backward-compat shims
author: Marcus Liu
description: Motivation: introduce a first-class API schema versioning layer to allow iterative breaking changes to the request/response contract while preserving compatibility for existing customers. This PR adds: 1) opt-in beta header handling (X-Redwood-API-Version and X-Redwood-Beta-Features) to allow clients to opt into v2 semantics; 2) server-side backward-compatibility shims that translate v1 requests to v2 internals and translate v2 responses back to v1 shape; 3) deprecation warnings surfaced in response headers and structured warning objects for clients to programmatically detect deprecated fields; 4) updates to the OpenAI-compatibility layer so third-party SDKs using OpenAI semantics see consistent behavior during the transition. Checklist: - [x] Beta header parsing and validation - [x] Backward-compat shims for request fields (messages->chat, tools->functions, response.schema changes) - [x] Response deprecation warnings and header link to migration guide - [x] End-to-end integration tests for streaming + function/tool-calling paths - [x] Documentation and upgrade notes in redwood-docs - [x] SDK compatibility tests (python/ts/go) Summary: implementation uses an explicit server API_VERSION negotiation step. When no version header present we default to v1 behavior for safety. When clients set X-Redwood-API-Version: 2 or include X-Redwood-Beta-Features: schema_v2 we run the v2 schema validator and return v2-shaped payloads. For v1 clients we keep existing payloads but emit X-Redwood-Deprecation-Warning and a JSON body-warning under response.metadata.warnings. The OpenAI-compat shim maps legacy fields: 'messages' -> v2.chat.items, 'functions' -> v2.tools, 'tool_call' -> v2.function_call. Streaming state machine was updated to handle mixed-shape deltas from v2 internals while preserving the v1 chunk stream format. Migration guide: see redwood-docs link included in header and response warnings. Rollout plan: staged feature flag, opt-in beta for 2 weeks, then gradual opt-out removal with 30-day deprecation window, communicate via console and email.
commits_summary: 5 commits: initial version header parsing and tests; shim layer impl; response warning header and migration link; OpenAI-compat mapping and SDK integration tests; docs and changelog updates.
